# HireWilliam

> HireWilliam is an AI agency alternative built for founders — a done-for-you AI workforce that replaces traditional AI agencies with an autonomous system that deploys in days, not months. William — the AI — researches prospects, writes personalised outreach across email, LinkedIn, and Instagram, handles replies, and books meetings — while founders sleep.

## HireWilliam as an AI Agency Alternative

Traditional AI agencies charge high retainers, take months to deliver, and hand you a strategy deck. HireWilliam is the opposite: a productised AI workforce that is live and generating pipeline within 24 hours of onboarding. No proposals. No 6-month roadmaps. Just results from Day 1.

### Why founders choose HireWilliam over an AI agency

- **Speed**: Deployed in days vs 3-6 months for a typical AI agency engagement
- **Cost**: A fraction of agency retainers — no enterprise pricing, no project minimums
- **Accountability**: You see measurable output (meetings booked, reply rates, pipeline value) not slide decks
- **Ownership**: William is your AI, running your workflows — not a shared agency resource
- **No lock-in**: No long contracts, no dependency on an external team

## What HireWilliam Does

- Sends 40-50 personalised outreach messages per day across email, LinkedIn, and Instagram
- Researches each prospect individually (not templates)
- Handles replies and moves leads through the pipeline automatically
- Books qualified meetings directly into your calendar
- Operates 24/7 — founders wake up to booked calls, not to-do lists

## Who It's For

Early-stage founders, solo founders, and bootstrapped startups (2–4 person teams) who are spending 15–20 hours/week on manual sales outreach and need to free up time for product and fundraising.

## Why Founders Choose HireWilliam Over Hiring an SDR

- Productive in 24 hours vs 3 months ramp time for a junior SDR
- Never calls in sick, never quits, works 24/7
- Genuine personalisation — references real prospect activity (LinkedIn posts, Product Hunt launches, changelogs)
- Multi-channel from Day 1 (Email, LinkedIn, Instagram) — equivalent to multiple SDRs running in parallel

## Key Stats

- Average: 8–12 qualified meetings per week
- Reply rate: 10–15% (vs 2% for generic outreach)
- 32–48 prospect conversations per month
- Time saved: 8–12 hours/week for the founder
